none: PAS NLM-609496: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin fragment. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Trier mint, Emperor on galley issue of 348-350, Reece period 18; broken with loss of nearly one third of flan; cf RIC volume 8 nos 259 and 259A. Obverse description: Bust draped and rosette diademed right, an effeminate portrait. Obverse inscription: [---]AVG. Reverse description: Emperor standing on galley holding labarum and sailing left, Victory steering in stern. Reverse inscription: FEL TEM(P REPARATIO). In exergue: TR[?S]. Diameter: 20.9mm, Weight [in excess of]: 4.02gms, die axis: 3
